method: Publish exactly three original leaves after exact-source full Linux CI and fresh independent behavioral/rendered review. Preserve prior343 IDs and assessments, native inventory and all unselected assessments except exact source anchor remaps and ancestor counts. Windows/macOS deferred; consumer and capture limits retained.

updates.assessment: File-size editor exposes five exclusive comparison radios (<,≈,=,≠,>) with clamped arrow navigation, Space and the default Enter path. Amount clamps to 0–1,048,576 and B/KB/MB/GB/TB remain separated binary units; selecting a unit does not convert the amount. Typed values reach the existing query executor with actual Qt hash outcomes for all operator/unit combinations and equality boundaries. Explicit supplied-value reconstruction preserves raw units in the model; native saved-default units persist/reopen and preserve unrelated default families. Cancel leaves the search unchanged. Hidden child/main or pending main questions refuse edits/acceptance; rebind and accepted exit cancel the owned main child, declined exit stays live, and a refused activation is consumed rather than resurrected later. Main-owned lifetime state retires the editor on actual Main-component destruction or final Bound-owner drop as well as rebind/accepted exit, hides owned notices and clears only its own slot. Nonfinal Bound clones, temporary Main hide and pending/declined exit retain the draft; retired/re-shown callbacks and Return cannot publish or change recents/defaults.

updates.assessment: The actual typed hash input uses the reference multiline placeholder and vertical four-type radio group (SHA-256, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-512), alongside its existing is/is-not group. Arrow navigation clamps at edges and Space selects. Upper/lower case, allowed algorithm prefixes, 0x prefixes and duplicate newline-separated hashes reach the existing typed query consumer; inclusive/exclusive and empty sets have recorded live query outcomes. Invalid or wrong-type acceptance preserves the draft and presents the exact prefixed Qt OK warning in an owned notice. Live physical text remains synchronized after cleanup, including an empty result. Cancel publishes nothing; explicit typed reconstruction preserves algorithm/sign in the model, while typed custom defaults persist/reopen natively and keep other default families. updates.assessment: The two cleanup buttons are stacked below the multiline input. Normal cleanup uses all four types, removes duplicate valid hashes and guesses a single algorithm only on success; bad/mixed/empty input is left untouched with its exact owned warning. The notice blocks parent edits/acceptance, refuses hidden acknowledgement, and retires on parent Cancel/rebind/accepted exit. Existing forced cleanup asks exact You sure?, No preserves text/type, and Yes removes bad lines, rewrites lowercase deduplicated text (including all-bad to empty), guesses only when unique, and otherwise keeps the selected type. Real typed input is visibly replaced through a two-way TextEdit draft. Existing confirmation/error assertions remain with real notice acknowledgement before continuing.
